purpose: One contained pretrained source-span-selector baseline on the unchanged two-example development slice. Establish syntax/range/expanded-validation and source-native coverage for the new representation before deciding any adapter fit.
modelLicence: Apache-2.0; retained pinned model receipt; local-files-only/safetensors/no remote code.

lexicalPolicy.flags: Python re.UNICODE default; no normalization or case folding.

acceptedParentRuntime.runtime: Fresh copy of the accepted CPython 3.11/torch 2.8.0+cu128/transformers 4.57.6 runtime; all runtime/model bytes pinned by the unchanged parent profile. No package or model acquisition.
acceptedParentRuntime.futureProfile: Stage a fresh private selector-baseline root; inspect generated freeze/profile/command against this assignment and use the existing guard to verify profile, OS no-egress token, Job limits, outputs and cleanup before acceptance.

lengthPolicy: Measure both source-only selector prompts with the pinned tokenizer before model loading, retain exact lexical view/codepoint offsets and Python/Unicode versions, and refuse over-limit input without truncation. No prompt/source/setting changes or automatic retry.
inferencePolicy: Fresh pretrained base only; no adapter, teacher targets, explanations, independent expectations or canonical targets in model input. Use the exact reviewed greedy generate/resource path. Preserve raw response before strict JSON/schema/range expansion and unchanged legacy semantic/family validation. Whole-response rejection; no repairs or partial accepted claims.

hostComparison.metricDefinition: On the host after guard/output/cleanup acceptance, compare only accepted expanded outputs with unchanged source-supported expectations by the original (role,state,literal,unit) signature, per example. Report unique accepted signatures/correct intersection/expected denominator, emitted claim count, source-native precision (null if none), coverage and valid no_canonical_targets abstentions separately. Report raw JSON/schema/range/expanded-validation counts and rejection stages separately. Rejected expansions receive zero accepted-claim credit. Do not use the old raw-text citation summarizer on selector arrays.
hostComparison.method: One short host-only in-memory comparison may write a new summary receipt outside the contained model stage. Do not change the frozen executable code before staging or edit existing summaries. Pin expected bytes before reading; never place expectations in the contained inputs/code/prompt.
hostComparison.qualification: Two related IFC development examples; exact source spans and validator acceptance are not independent semantic accuracy. No natural conflict accuracy or canonical matching/generalization/operational qualification is supported.

developmentCriteriaBeforeAnyLaterEvaluat.nullAndAbsentStates: Preserve distinct source-supported null and absent states; no invented values.
developmentCriteriaBeforeAnyLaterEvaluat.resourcesAndCleanup: Existing measured caps and containment/cleanup acceptance all pass.
developmentCriteriaBeforeAnyLaterEvaluat.interpretation: Predeclared tiny development criteria only. This baseline cannot authorize fitting, opening evaluation or promotion automatically; inspect actual errors and return for the next bounded assignment.

ownership: This learner alone owns the model/GPU phase and new baseline evidence/handoff. Existing coordinator schema/family/data/teacher files, old code/runs, staging, shared containment/resources/dependencies, frontend, services and gateway stay read-only. No source/model acquisitions or provider calls.

settingsRequired.observedTurnSettings: Report actual supplied permissions and model/effort/tier only when exposed. Dispatch has no tier field; a prompt does not configure speed.

continuation: One fresh stage and one contained baseline only. On any execution/resource/length/pin failure, preserve raw/artifacts and return the exact blocker without retries or broad repairs. Return profile/freeze/prompt/input/code hashes, guard/cleanup evidence, raw outputs, separate validator and independent host metrics, actual latency/resources and exact owned evidence commit. Callback only to the ML coordinator and stop; no fit, evaluation or automatic continuation.
teacherFeedback: Teacher remains idle and receives no development/evaluation contents, expected labels or predictions.
